name: Grand Forks County, ND
findings: Grand Forks County has 284 nonprofit organizations. 143 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 121 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Grand Forks County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 39 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Grand Forks County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 64 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 26 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
